title: Canonical Graph Node — UI Layer
description: Document in index Elasticsearch ods-graph-nodes for UI-layer (screens, controls, styles). Same index as code/system; filter via metadata.layer=ui. ES _id = {analysis_run_id}:{id}.

kind.description: UI-layer node type in the canonical graph

name.description: Short name for Graph UI and search

qualified_name.description: Full key: route path, component FQN, control id, …

path.description: Primary source file in working copy

element_id.description: FK → ods-elements when path maps to project tree

parent_id.description: id of parent UI node (screen→frame→control); nullable for ui_app

signature.description: Route pattern, control_kind, HTTP method+path hint, surface library; nullable

metadata.description: layer=ui plus framework, control_kind, field_name, label_key, query_params, class_names, …

layer.description: Layer marker for UI filter / Graph UI
